title: Building in the social events economy in 2026
decision: Choose a defensible UK launch wedge across friendship dating talks craft games sport and local discovery using non-UK companies only to test transferable mechanisms.
methods: Google Ads GenerateKeywordHistoricalMetrics through the repository's authenticated read-only runner
Canonical keyword baskets with national and London observations kept separate where overlap is plausible
Current live-web review of operator homepages event listings pricing terms privacy safety and help pages
Primary regulator and government evidence for UK social conditions event risk consumer terms data protection and online safety
SEC filings and official results for public-company revenue and payer evidence
Current UK government and British Business Bank evidence for seed-market conditions and finance routes
First-party founder and investor materials used as attributed capital comparables rather than audited performance
Volume-weighted CPC calculated as sum of search volume multiplied by CPC divided by total search volume
Scenario unit economics using observed Dinners With Friends seat and host terms with all other inputs explicitly excluded or assumed
Weighted archetype scorecard used as a decision aid rather than an empirical forecast
Bottom-up capital budgets raise gates and dilution illustrations used as planning scenarios rather than financing advice
2027 to 2030 scenario planning used to test which present-day assets remain useful across divergent futures
Current-company census across 44 managed event activity platform and infrastructure operators
Second Google Ads historical-metrics pull for UK activity categories
Selected European and North American operators used as mechanism comparators rather than UK demand evidence
Cross-format contribution scenarios with every non-observed price capacity and cost marked as an assumption
Revenue mechanisms sequenced by the audience format rights venue or network asset required
exclusions: Brand-search terms from generic category totals
London keyword variants from national basket totals
Historical non-UK Timeleft prices from the UK commercial model
Unverified operator retention acquisition cost profit and incident rates
Investor outreach term sheets and financing availability for the proposed company
Brand-only Companies House matching without an authoritative legal identifier
Broad things-to-do events-near-me and classes-near-me terms from activity category totals
All non-UK keyword volume from the UK market analysis
Operator downloads registrations followers or claimed attendees as active paying customers
Restaurant studio facility or marketplace gross booking value as company revenue
limitations: Average monthly searches are rounded trailing historical averages and not obtainable traffic.
Google Ads may group or suppress close variants and zero-return rows are not proof of zero demand.
Friendship discovery phrases include mixed commercial informational and community intent.
Operator scale attendance and satisfaction statements are first-party unless explicitly identified otherwise.
Dinners With Friends publishes inconsistent participation totals and start-date wording across live pages.
Timeleft UK subscription pricing was not visible without account signup.
Capital budgets valuations dilution and operating gates are illustrative scenarios rather than observed offers or market benchmarks.
The 2027 to 2030 cases are scenarios rather than probability-weighted forecasts.
First-party funding and operating claims for private companies are not audited unless explicitly stated otherwise.
The report contains no original attendee host venue or operator interviews.
No event was attended and no checkout registration campaign production mutation or Supabase query was performed.
Activity keywords overlap and include family tourist retail informational and commercial intent so they are not summed into a market size.
Selected international operators demonstrate mechanisms and are not evidence of UK demand price or transferability.
The operator census is a mechanism map rather than proof that all 44 products are profitable or direct competitors.
Cross-format contribution cases are planning scenarios and should not be read as operator benchmarks.
Liiiv public terms disclose monetisation mechanisms but its live price list take rate active users GMV and revenue remain unknown.
